description: WRITES a doc from Markdown. Without card_id it adds a new doc card (in free space, in group, or at the top-left); with card_id it adds pages to that doc, after its pages or under parent_page_id. Headings, lists, checklists (- [ ] / - [x]), tables, quotes, code, links, ==highlight== and <u>underline</u> carry over. A picture is placed only from a file already on the board, as ![caption](r2:<image_key>) (image_key from read_board); other pictures become links.

card_id.description: A doc card to add the pages to; left out, a new doc

draft.description: The draft key create_boards returned. Pass it on every call about that draft.

group.description: A new doc's section (made if missing)

parent_page_id.description: With card_id: the page these go under

position.description: "top": top-left, ahead of the sections (not with group, x, y)

title.description: A new doc's title; left out, its one page's title

x.description: A new doc's left edge; x and y left out, free space

name: write_doc
title: Write doc
